portfolio.sectionSubtitle: Real solutions delivering real results for our clients

items.title: Wall of Fame — Angel Sponsor
items.description: A tribute page and interactive showcase dedicated to project sponsors and contributors.
items.problem: Sponsors needed a prominent, interactive way to showcase their branding.
items.solution: Created a grid wall with smooth hover effects, custom cards, and direct links.
items.result: Improved sponsor visibility and increased engagement by 40%.

items.title: Live at Probolinggo
items.description: A local tourism and community platform providing live event updates and travel guides.
items.problem: Lack of centralized, modern portal for tourists and local events.
items.solution: Built a responsive platform featuring interactive event calendars and guides.
items.result: Became a popular community resource with rising monthly visitors.

items.title: Misaiwan Fish Marketplace
items.description: A specialized e-commerce platform connecting local fishermen directly with consumers.
items.problem: Fishermen struggled to find buyers directly without middlemen.
items.solution: Developed a simple, direct-to-consumer digital seafood marketplace.
items.result: Enabled fair pricing for fishermen and fresher choices for buyers.

items.title: UMKM Self Service
items.description: A digital self-service portal empowering local small businesses to register and manage products.
items.problem: Small businesses lacked accessible tools to manage digital sales.
items.solution: Designed an intuitive, mobile-friendly product builder and service portal.
items.result: Accelerated digital onboarding for over 100+ local micro-merchants.

items.title: Propose Love
items.description: A creative, interactive web experience for making proposals and special announcements.
items.problem: Traditional text messages lack personal, interactive storytelling.
items.solution: Created a playful interactive page with custom responses and animations.
items.result: A delightful viral template used by couples to celebrate relationships.

items.title: Hobby Hands Recognition
items.description: An AI-powered computer vision tool to detect and recognize hand gestures in real time.
items.problem: Building accessible hand gesture controls usually requires heavy hardware.
items.solution: Implemented MediaPipe and TensorFlow.js for lightweight in-browser recognition.
items.result: Achieved sub-50ms latency for gesture tracking in modern browsers.

items.title: Photobooth Six Taupe
items.description: An interactive web-based digital photo booth app with custom overlays and instant download.
items.problem: Expensive hardware setups are required for event photo booths.
items.solution: Built a serverless web app utilizing the user's camera with custom frames.
items.result: Easily deployable on tablets or laptops at local community events.

items.title: Inspeksi Palembang
items.description: An inspection logging and monitoring dashboard built for Palembang municipal infrastructure.
items.problem: Manual paper-based reports delayed municipal maintenance responses.
items.solution: Developed a digital dashboard with geotagging and real-time status tracking.
items.result: Reduced processing delay for critical municipal reports by 50%.

items.title: Aqiqah Alyssa
items.description: An elegant, comprehensive landing page for booking and customizing traditional Aqiqah services.
items.problem: Customers found ordering traditional catering services complex.
items.solution: Designed a simplified ordering flow with price packages and customization options.
items.result: Boosted online inquiries and simplified booking administration.

items.title: Life Calculator Chi
items.description: An interactive life progress calculator designed to help users track age milestones and habits.
items.problem: Static calendars fail to give perspective on long-term time visualization.
items.solution: Developed a grid dashboard mapping life phases by weeks and percentage progress.
items.result: Encouraged mindful planning and habit tracking among active users.

items.title: K-Pop Demon Hunter Piano Tiles
items.description: An action-packed music rhythm game blending K-Pop tracks with fast piano tile gameplay.
items.problem: Lack of anime-style K-Pop themed games on the Google Play store.
items.solution: Developed a Unity-based game featuring trendy music and custom graphics.
items.result: Reached thousands of active players with highly positive review scores.

items.title: Sahur Brainrot Piano Tiles
items.description: A viral, meme-themed music game with fun soundtracks themed around traditional Sahur callings.
items.problem: Lack of lighthearted, local culture-inspired games for Ramadan.
items.solution: Created a piano game featuring popular internet sounds and memes.
items.result: Gained high community traction and shared virally across social media.

items.title: Magic Piano Game: Music Tiles 7
items.description: A professional piano emulator game featuring classic and modern songs with multi-instrument choices.
items.problem: Many rhythm games have heavy lags and bad audio synchronization.
items.solution: Optimized audio latency rendering pipeline on Android devices.
items.result: Provided extremely smooth audio feedback with a 4.5+ star store rating.

items.title: MJ Piano Tiles Game
items.description: A rhythm-based tribute piano game dedicated to iconic pop beats and dance soundtracks.
items.problem: Fans of dance music wanted a dedicated rhythm game for retro pop tracks.
items.solution: Created stylized dark-neon interfaces themed around classic dance movements.
items.result: Highly rated by nostalgic players globally.

items.title: Frogo SDK
items.description: A unified software development kit providing boilerplate helpers, AdMob integrators, and UI components.
items.problem: Developers spend too much time repeating basic boilerplate setup.
items.solution: Bundled common Android utilities, view bindings, and ads helpers into a single package.
items.result: Widely used by the developer community with hundreds of GitHub stars.

items.title: Kick Start Android Template
items.description: A modern, state-of-the-art boilerplate repository for Android development using best practices.
items.problem: Setting up a clean MVVM structure is tedious and error-prone for beginners.
items.solution: Created a ready-to-run template with preconfigured architecture patterns.
items.result: Helped developers boot up production-grade apps in minutes.

items.title: Kick Start Android WebView
items.description: A customizable hybrid app template to bundle web applications into native Android containers.
items.problem: Basic WebViews in Android have issues with downloads, permissions, and history.
items.solution: Engineered a robust WebView wrapper resolving security, files, and navigation out-of-the-box.
items.result: Used in production by numerous developers to compile progressive web apps.

items.title: Frogo RecyclerView
items.description: An easy-to-use library to build complex list layouts on Android with zero boilerplate adapter.
items.problem: Writing custom RecyclerView Adapters and ViewHolders in Android is repetitive.
items.solution: Designed a generic adapter structure leveraging Kotlin generics and closures.
items.result: Reduced list implementation code by up to 70%.

items.title: Custom Android Keyboard Library
items.description: A boilerplate template and toolkit for creating custom virtual keyboards on Android.
items.problem: Android Input Method Editor (IME) API is notoriously complex to implement from scratch.
items.solution: Abstracted the keyboard service setup into a developer-friendly layout configuration.
items.result: Empowered developers to build specialized, themed, and security keyboards.

items.title: Automated Android Build Action
items.description: A complete GitHub Actions workflow for building, signing, and releasing Android APKs automatically.
items.problem: Manual signing and sharing of test builds consumes valuable developer time.
items.solution: Created a robust CI/CD template that builds APKs and uploads them to releases on every push.
items.result: Simplified distribution of nightly builds for collaborative projects.

ceo.bio: I am an Android Developer with a strong passion for building real-world applications and continuously improving my technical skills. I am highly motivated to grow in fast-paced environments where I can face real challenges, solve problems, and gain hands-on experience in software development. Currently, I am seeking opportunities to expand my experience through real projects and collaborative work environments.
